name: bilibili-subtitles-monorepo
description: Bilibili subtitle tools and host integrations

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @fukangz/core-bilibili-subtitles && npm run build --workspace @fukangz/cli-bilibili-subtitles && npm run build --workspace @fukangz/dsh-bilibili-subtitles
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/*.test.mjs && npm test --workspaces --if-present
